test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A is thrice as good a workman as B and is, therefore, able to finish a job in 60 days less than B. Working together, they can do it in:
solution:
**Given:**

A is thrice as good a workman as B.

A can finish the job 60 days less than B.

**Formula Used:**

If A can do a piece of work in n days, then B will take 3n days to complete the same work.

Work Rate of A = 1/n

Work Rate of B = 1/(3n)

Combined Work Rate = Work Rate of A + Work Rate of B

Time taken working together = 1 / (Combined Work Rate)

**Calculation:**

Let B take n days to finish the job.

Then, A will take (n - 60) days.

Since A is thrice as good as B:

n - 60 = n/3

⇒ 3(n - 60) = n

⇒ 3n - 180 = n

⇒ 2n = 180

⇒ n = 90

So, B takes 90 days to finish the job.

A takes 30 days to finish the job.

Combined Work Rate = 1/30 + 1/90

⇒ (3 + 1) / 90

⇒ 4/90

⇒ 2/45

Time taken working together = 1 / (2/45)

⇒ 45/2

⇒ 22.5 days

**The correct answer is option 2 (22.5 days).**
